{{Quote|You wanna buy some death sticks?''"<br />"''You don't want to sell me death sticks.''"<br />"''Uh, I don't wanna sell you death sticks.''"<br />"''You want to go home and rethink your life.''"<br />"''I wanna go home and rethink my life.|[[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] under the influence of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] mind trick|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
'''Death sticks''' were a mild hallucinogen drug primarily sold on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds, but could be found in abundance on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Originally developed in the illegal pharmaceutical labs of [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]], they were relatively cheap and were smuggled into the clubs of cities by [[Slythmonger/Legends|slythmongers]].

==History==
{{Quote|Death sticks, ''terrible'' stuff!|Rozatta to [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] |<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Deathstick-Holonet.jpg|thumb|left|150px|"Are your children safe?" - An image used in [[Anjet Okeco]]'s [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] article]]
Death sticks were a devastating factor in [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] society. Pollution was one of the causes of the heavy addiction to death sticks, but the Balosars' immunity to toxins allowed them to consume them without much effect other than the life-long addiction. Some Balosars even entered the death stick business, where they would travel in hopes of finding potential customers.<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

During the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], illegal trade in death sticks became the greatest competition to the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] called [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]]. The rivalry resulted in a hatred between the Balosars and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]].<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

In 34 BBY, [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] leader [[Komari Vosa]] [[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter|struck a deal]] with [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]], Senator [[Connus Trell]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], and the powerful [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] death-stick kingpin [[Sebolto]] to distribute contaminated death sticks, as a means of supplying the Bando Gora with "brain dead" recruits.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

Shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Bando Gora distributed a more potent and deadly form of death stick to gather more members until the cult was destroyed by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="BH" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] tried to sell [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] death sticks, but Kenobi used a [[Mind trick/Legends|Jedi mind trick]] to convince him he did not want to sell them to Kenobi, then to convince him to stop selling death sticks altogether, which resulted in Elan "going home to rethink his life."<ref name="Episode II" />

At another point, reporter [[Anjet Okeco]] wrote an article for [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] about the use of death sticks among [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] youth with [[Coruscant Health Official]]s estimating millions of children using them.<ref name="HNN 49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_1.html|SPECIAL REPORT: The Death Stick Scourge}}</ref> Soon after, two students at a sub-adult school in the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] were found in possession of death sticks.<ref name="HNN 53">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_3.html|Death Sticks found in Subadult School}}</ref>
